en.title: #MascaraRecommendation No Need for False Eyelashes
en.description:
I bought #Romand #HanAllFauxLashMascara
because I heard it gives you 🦊fox-like, individual lashes 👀💸

I wanted to try using it with you guys,
so I filmed myself using it… This is actually pretty good! 😳👍

But if you want those perfectly neat strands like in the advertisements ❌
you absolutely need tweezers!!!

But it gives a nice, full, voluminous look
so I'd recommend it if you're looking for a mascara that delivers both volume and length.
The curl stays put all day long, so the staying power is 👍
(I danced, worked up a sweat, and did all that, and it was still perfect,
and it even stayed put when I cried!)

Oh right! If you want that super clean, individually-defined
lash look like Etude Curl Fix
I wouldn't recommend this!!

What do you all think of this mascara?

🏷️ Roman Han All Faux Lash Mascara
Regular price: 16,000 won (Currently on sale for 9,900 won at Zigzag)

zh-Hant.description:
🦊fox 般的根根分明睫毛，聽說能打造這種效果才買的
#rom&nd #HAN ALL FAUX LASH MASCARA 👀💸

因為想和各位一起試用看看，
所以一邊拍攝一邊使用了… 這個很不錯耶 😳👍

不過， 並不像廣告那樣能刷出乾淨整齊的根根分明感 ❌
一定要準備鑷子才行！！！

但因為能呈現出帶有豐盈感且聚攏的感覺，
如果是正在尋找濃密 + 纖長兩者兼具， 非常推薦。
捲翹度也是一整天都不會塌， 持久力也 👍
( 跳完舞又流了汗都還好好的，
就算哭了也沒事呢？ )

對了！ 如果想要像 Etude Curl Fix 那樣非常乾淨、

will instantly take your makeup to the next level! ✨

These are the two brow mascara products
I've been using a lot lately, but the colors are slightly different.

1️⃣ 2aN Art Coloring Brow Cara
02 Ash Cocoa / 12,000 won (personally purchased)

👉 A subtle ash beige with no yellow undertones
so it's also recommended for cool skin tones.
You can get it for just 9,000 won when it's on sale!

2️⃣ Peripera Speedy Skinny Brow Mascara
06 Beige Ash / 8,000 won (personally purchased)

👉 A browcara I mainly use for soft spring warm
and fall warm makeup looks. It offers the best value for the price.

As long as the brow pencil isn't too dark
you can just use the one you've been using!
I found that the color of the brow mascara is more important🫶🏻

📢[1인 1개 구매 제한]

📢[교환/반품 불가]
• 민스코 박스는 ‘기부 캠페인’ 취지로 진행되는 한정 구성으로, 
구매 후 유의사항 미숙지 등 단순 변심에 의한 교환 및 반품이 불가합니다.

📢[배송 안내]

📢[결제 완료 순 출고]
